comments: One possibility is previewing media files via MTP. However, it is not appropriate to uniformly disable previews because MTP may or may not support streaming on different devices.

review_comments: Could unloaded objects be reused? I don't know but if it is, this will cause the event to not work the next time it is loaded.
I can confirm that it's not an issue here.
